run_strafe_actions: run the habitat-lab example to execute strafe left and right actions in the simulation environment
create_StrafeActionConfig: create a StrafeActionConfig dataclass with move_amount and noise_amount parameters for strafe actions
build_StrafeLeft: build a StrafeLeft task action class that strafes the agent 90 degrees to the left
build_StrafeRight: build a StrafeRight task action class that strafes the agent 90 degrees to the right
refactor__strafe_body: refactor the _strafe_body helper to modify how agent position and rotation are computed during strafing
